name: ZCA_ORCH_DT_STEP_TASKS
description: Contains the list of tasks and their related information of a given orchestration Task Step.

columns.name: STEP_TASKS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration step tasks object.

columns.name: STEP_TASKS_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier (Alternate Key) of the Orchestration step tasks object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration stage object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STEP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration steps object.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the activity template (Task, Appointment, etc.)

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the activity id within the activity template.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Order of the tasks in the Orchestration admin and runtime UIs.

columns.name: SMART_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the smart action.

columns.name: FIELD_UPDATE_JSON
columns.description: JSON structure containing the list of fields to update on source object.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO
columns.description: Contains to whom the activity should be assigned to when generated. Possible values are OWNER, TEAM MEMBER and CUSTOM CONDITION

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO_RULE
columns.description: Contains the rule when AssignedTo is specified as CUSTOM_CONDITION

columns.name: EMAIL_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the email template which will be defaulted at run time.

columns.name: WAIT_FOR_REPLIES_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether or not to wait for the inbound email as a reply.

columns.name: IA_TEMPLATE_VALUE
columns.description: Name of the intelligent advisor guide template.

columns.name: GRACE_PERIOD
columns.description: Specifies the number of hours to wait before treating the Step as failed. This is applicable for manual steps alone.

columns.name: ALLOW_SKIP_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether or not to show skip or thumbs down icon in guidance primary or secondary banner.

columns.name: EVALUATE_ON_MARKCOMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether or not to evaluate the success criteria when task/appointment is marked as complete.

columns.name: STEP_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of Step Template.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
